english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb when something causes mental distress or persistently affects someone physically.
This is the all-purpose choice when a memory or past event troubles someone.
Use 困擾 as the all-purpose choice when a problem, illness, or calamity troubles someone.
Use this as the all-purpose verb when something troubles or weighs on someone's mind.
Use this when the disturbance is specifically causing emotional distress, worry, or confusion.
Use this when a thought, comment, or problem keeps causing someone deep worry.
Use this when the harassment means causing someone continuing worry, distress, or a heavy mental burden.
